notes: Full historical ledger of reported U.S. government statements about oil and vessel movement through Hormuz and Gulf bypass routes. History is never overwritten: corrections, denials and supersessions are preserved as linked rows.
Not guaranteed complete: statements occur in gaggles, interviews, deleted posts and anonymous briefings. See the collection protocol in US_OIL_FLOW_CLAIMS_DATABASE_BRIEF.md.

sources_swept: official channels (White House, DOE, CENTCOM/DoD, presidential social accounts)
specialist press (Axios, WSJ, Bloomberg, S&P, USNI, Lloyd's List and similar)
_coverage.note: Rows are normalized figures, not statements: one public statement can produce several rows (statement_event_id groups them). Completeness is bounded to located statements; collection effort varies by month and channel.

claims.notes: Quote: 'The running average today is almost 13 million barrels a day.' Averaging window not stated. Al Jazeera (Sep 28) paraphrased it as 'nearly 13 million barrels of crude'. Kpler's seven-day crude average through Hormuz at the time was about 13.5 million barrels per day (per The National).
claims.source_title: US Energy Secretary: 13 million barrels a day flowing through Hormuz, one day hit 20 million

claims.speaker: Donald Trump
claims.claim_text: Said a record amount of oil, more than before the war, had been taken out of the Hormuz Strait the previous night.
claims.notes: Quote: 'Last night, we took a record amount of oil out of the Hormuz Strait, more than we took out before the war.' No figure given. Also reported by TASS.
claims.source_title: Trump Says Record Amount of Oil Transported Through Hormuz Strait

claims.speaker: Chris Wright
claims.claim_text: Said that on one day in the past week over 20 million barrels of oil, more than pre-conflict levels, had flowed out of the strait.
claims.notes: Quote: 'There was a day just this last week where over 20 million barrels of oil, more than pre-conflict levels, flowed out of the strait.' Day not identified.
claims.source_title: US Energy Secretary: 13 million barrels a day flowing through Hormuz, one day hit 20 million
claims.time_basis_plain: one day in the previous week

claims.speaker: Scott Bessent
claims.claim_text: Said Iran loaded zero crude oil onto tankers in September.
claims.notes: Quote: 'Iran loaded ZERO crude oil onto tankers in September.' Posted alongside Treasury sanctions announcements under Operation Economic Outcast.
claims.source_title: Bessent says Iran loaded no crude onto tankers in September

claims.speaker: Donald Trump
claims.claim_text: Said record numbers of barrels were coming out of the Strait of Hormuz on an almost daily basis, so the strait was no longer what was driving up gasoline prices.
claims.notes: Post of 12:32 PM EDT. Quote: 'What's driving up Gasoline is no longer the Strait of Hormuz, because Record Numbers of Barrels are coming out now on an almost daily basis, but the word, "Refineries"...' Qualitative; no figure.
claims.source_title: Donald J. Trump Truth Social post, October 5, 2026

claims.speaker: Adm. Brad Cooper
claims.claim_text: Said U.S. forces had redirected 130 commercial vessels since enforcement of the blockade resumed on July 14.
claims.notes: Quote: 'The US military remains intensely focused on this mission. We will swiftly act against any vessels trying to run the blockade.' Also reported by IranWire. Intermediate readings between 105 (Sep 18) and 130 were posted by CENTCOM but not located with exact dates.
claims.source_title: CENTCOM says 130 vessels redirected under US blockade of Iran

claims.speaker: Adm. Brad Cooper
claims.claim_text: Said U.S. forces had destroyed 13 commercial vessels over the past 12 weeks that were violating the blockade or were part of the IRGC shadow network.
claims.notes: CENTCOM's Oct 10 post gave '10 tankers destroyed linked to IRGC operations' (USOF-20261010-04); the two counts may use different categories. Recorded side by side.
claims.source_title: CENTCOM says 130 vessels redirected under US blockade of Iran

claims.speaker: Adm. Brad Cooper
claims.claim_text: Said U.S. forces had disabled three ships that refused to comply with the blockade.
claims.source_title: CENTCOM says 130 vessels redirected under US blockade of Iran

claims.speaker: Donald Trump
claims.channel: remarks to reporters before departing for Maryland
claims.claim_text: Said millions of barrels of oil had been delivered through the Hormuz Strait over the last couple of days, at levels even with and sometimes exceeding those before the war.
claims.notes: Quotes: 'The Hormuz Strait, tremendous amounts, millions of barrels of oil, has been delivered just over the last couple of days'; 'We're getting it through at levels that are now even and sometimes exceeding prior to the war.' Also claimed Iran's oil minister had quit. No figure. ANI dated the remarks Tuesday Oct 6.
claims.source_title: Trump says 'millions of barrels' of oil transited through Hormuz

claims.speaker: Marco Rubio
claims.claim_text: Said there was almost as much oil flowing out of the strait now as there was before the conflict began.
claims.notes: Quote: 'There's almost as much oil flowing out now as there was before this conflict began.' No figure. Kpler's seven-day Middle East crude export average was 18.3 million barrels per day on Sep 30 vs about 18 million pre-war (per The National).
claims.source_title: Iran has 'lost complete control' of Strait of Hormuz, US claims

claims.speaker: Marco Rubio
claims.claim_text: Said the Strait of Hormuz was open and that Iran had lost complete control of it.
claims.notes: Quote: 'The Strait of Hormuz is open... So they've lost complete control of the strait.' CBS live updates timed the remarks at 7:18 AM ET.
claims.source_title: Iran has 'lost complete control' of Strait of Hormuz, US claims

claims.speaker: U.S. Central Command
claims.claim_text: Said an IRGC general's claim that the Strait of Hormuz was closed and under Iranian control was false, that traffic was flowing, and that the United States and regional partners clearly controlled the strait.
claims.notes: Quote: 'CLAIM: ... "the Strait of Hormuz is closed" ... This is FALSE. FACT: Traffic is flowing through the Strait of Hormuz right now carrying commercial goods and energy supplies... The United States and regional partners clearly control the strait.' Posted the day Iran's IRGC asserted closure; Iran disputes.
claims.source_title: US CENTCOM rejects Iran's claim of Hormuz closure, says 20 million barrels of crude moving through

claims.speaker: U.S. Central Command
claims.claim_text: Said traffic flowing through the strait included 20 million barrels of crude oil.
claims.notes: Quote: '...including 20 million barrels of crude oil.' Time basis not stated ('right now'); unclear whether a day, a night or vessels in transit.
claims.source_title: US CENTCOM rejects Iran's claim of Hormuz closure, says 20 million barrels of crude moving through

claims.speaker: Donald Trump
claims.claim_text: Said oil was flowing in record numbers of barrels through the Hormuz Strait, 22 million barrels the previous night alone.
claims.notes: Post of 12:45 PM EDT (per CBS News live updates). Quote: '...with oil flowing in record numbers of barrels through the Hormuz Strait (22 million barrels, last night alone, with not one barrel coming from, or going to, Iran), we will not be attacking Iran at any time prior to the midterm elections...' Previous night was Oct 7. Exceeds the roughly 20 million barrels a day the strait carried before the war. Shipping Telegraph and Axios also reported the post.
claims.source_title: Donald Trump says US will not launch strikes against Iran before midterms

claims.speaker: Donald Trump
claims.claim_text: Said not one barrel of the previous night's oil was coming from, or going to, Iran, and that the blockade would remain in full force.
claims.notes: Same post as USOF-20261008-01.
claims.source_title: Donald Trump says US will not launch strikes against Iran before midterms

claims.speaker: U.S. Central Command
claims.claim_text: Said U.S. forces had secured the transport of more than 1.25 billion barrels of crude oil from Gulf partners through the Strait of Hormuz in recent months.
claims.notes: Value recorded as 1250 million barrels. Quote (translated): 'In recent months, US forces have secured the transportation of more than 1.25 billion barrels of crude oil from partners in the Persian Gulf region through the Strait of Hormuz.' Also said thousands of commercial vessels had passed safely. Later reading of the same cumulative series as USOF-20260919-01. Also reported by IranWire.
claims.source_title: CENTCOM announced assistance in transporting 1.25 billion barrels of oil through Hormuz

claims.speaker: U.S. Central Command
claims.claim_text: Said Iranian oil exports from its ports had ground to a halt under the U.S. blockade.
claims.notes: Qualitative; no figure in the report.
claims.source_title: CENTCOM announced assistance in transporting 1.25 billion barrels of oil through Hormuz

claims.speaker: U.S. Central Command
claims.claim_text: Said U.S. forces had redirected 133 commercial vessels as of October 9 to ensure compliance with the blockade.
claims.notes: Quote: 'As of Oct. 9, U.S. forces have redirected 133 commercial vessels to ensure compliance.'
claims.source_title: CENTCOM: US redirects 133 vessels under Iran blockade

claims.speaker: U.S. Central Command
claims.claim_text: Said 135 ships had been turned around during three months of strict blockade enforcement.
claims.notes: Wikipedia cites the same figure from CENTCOM for Oct 10.
claims.source_title: US military says it disabled vessel attempting to violate blockade

claims.speaker: U.S. Central Command
claims.claim_text: Said a U.S. fighter jet had disabled the Panama-flagged cargo vessel Ocean Molica in the Gulf of Oman after it left an Iranian port and tried to run the blockade.
claims.notes: Also known as 'Arika Sun'. Struck on the stern to disable propulsion; CENTCOM said no crew were harmed. CENTCOM X post: https://x.com/CENTCOM/status/2109073217176637447. Also reported by The Hill.
claims.source_title: US military says it disabled vessel attempting to violate blockade

claims.speaker: U.S. Central Command
claims.claim_text: Said four commercial vessels had now been disabled during three months of blockade enforcement.
claims.source_title: US military says it disabled vessel attempting to violate blockade

claims.speaker: U.S. Central Command
claims.claim_text: Said 10 tankers linked to IRGC operations had been destroyed.
claims.notes: Differs from the Oct 5 count of 13 commercial vessels destroyed over 12 weeks (USOF-20261005-03); categories may differ (tankers vs all vessels). Recorded side by side, not as a correction.
claims.source_title: US military says it disabled vessel attempting to violate blockade
